title: Specifying min/max for rangeSlider automatically displays the min/max values in currentRefinements
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

If you specify the min/max options for a `rangeSlider` widget and use the `currentRefinements` widget to display the user's refinements, the min and max values for the `rangeSlider` will be treated as active refinements, even if Instant Search loads in a default state when the user has not refined any attributes.

This seems to have been covered before (see issue #[2909](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/2909)) and that issue mentioned that this behaviour has been 'fixed in v3' but that doesn't appear to be the case. The `rangeSlider`/`currentRefinements` documentation also doesn't mention that this will happen.

You can use the `clearRefinements `widget to clear the initial unwanted rangeSlider refinements, but refining by any other attribute will add them back in place.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**

Test case reproduced [here](https://codesandbox.io/s/bold-joliot-k99ngo)

## 💭 Expected behavior

Defining a min and max value for the rangeSlider simply sets those as the minimum and maximum selectable values and does not consider them to be refinements until the user changes either value from its default.
